policy: Use official MathWorks documentation/examples as provenance. Resolve exact local example/model/block paths from the user's installed MATLAB release before copying modules.

examples.title: Design, Operate, and Control Remote Microgrid
examples.entry_hint: Open the MicrogridDesignWithSimscape project from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Prefer coherent source/BESS/load/controller subsystems rather than the whole project.

examples.title: Design and Analyze Grid-Forming Converter
examples.entry_hint: Open the GridFormingConverterWithSimscape project from the upstream project.
examples.extract_policy: Keep plant, inner control, active-power control, current-limiting method, and test harness boundaries explicit.

examples.title: Model Doubly-Fed Induction Generator Wind Power System
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Choose simplified or detailed DFIG according to the study objective; do not mix their internal fidelity assumptions.

examples.title: Wind Turbine
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: The lumped generator is intentionally lower fidelity; preserve that choice when used for supervisory/pitch studies.

examples.title: Three-Phase Grid-Connected Solar Photovoltaic System
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Preserve the chosen inverter variant and MPPT/control assumptions; use the average model for control design unless switching detail is required.

examples.title: Single-Phase Grid-Connected Solar Photovoltaic System
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Use only for single-phase architectures unless the controller is deliberately generalized.

examples.title: Peak Shaving with Battery Energy Storage System
examples.entry_hint: Use the installed peak-shaving BESS example and its initialization scripts.
examples.extract_policy: Keep battery module, BMS, converter, and supervisory controller as separate modules; preserve SOC protection logic when reusing the BESS.

examples.title: Model a Three-Phase PMSM Drive
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Select motor/inverter detail according to switching-timing or control-design needs.

examples.title: Simscape Electrical Asynchronous Machines
examples.entry_hint: Resolve the selected induction-machine block from the installed library.
examples.extract_policy: Choose the lowest machine fidelity that captures slip/rotor behavior required by the study.

examples.title: IEEE 9-Bus System
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Useful as a benchmark and as a coherent synchronous-generator control subsystem source; retain load-flow initialization when extracting machine modules.

examples.title: Distance Relay Protection in AC Microgrid
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Keep relay sampling time, system frequency, fault type, breaker timing, and measurement filtering consistent.

examples.title: Fault (Three-Phase)
examples.entry_hint: Resolve the Fault (Three-Phase) block from the installed Simscape Electrical Utilities library.
examples.extract_policy: Check the release-specific three-phase connection parameter; R2026a introduces the composite/expanded electrical connection option.

examples.title: High-Voltage, Direct-Current Transmission Using Voltage Source Converters
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Use the example's fidelity/solver variant controls as a pattern; do not mix sampling settings from different fidelity variants.

examples.title: Model High-Voltage Direct-Current Transmission Using Modular Multilevel Converters
examples.entry_hint: Open Model from the installed example/documentation.
examples.extract_policy: Preserve variant-controlled fidelity, sample-time configuration, and operating-point initialization workflow.

examples.title: ThreePhaseExamples library
examples.extract_policy: Use as a source-code/template library; rename customized Simscape components before building a custom library.

examples.title: Perform a Load-Flow Analysis Using Simscape Electrical
examples.entry_hint: Use the documented load-flow workflow for operating-point initialization.
examples.extract_policy: Use for initialization and source-model selection rather than as a generic EMT subsystem.

examples.title: Simscape Electrical Transformers
examples.entry_hint: Resolve the required transformer block from the installed Simscape Electrical library.
examples.extract_policy: Match connection group, nominal frequency, voltage bases, saturation choice, and per-unit/SI parameterization.

examples.title: Specialized Power Systems Conversion Assistant
examples.extract_policy: Use for migration, then re-run simulation and compare signals before accepting the converted model.
